question: Extend the executive-pay screen to community foundations ranked 51-250 by DAF assets (TY2021-24) and allocate top-officer pay and Part IX lines 5-10 to DAF administration by DAF share of assets and of grants, to test whether the weak scale elasticity of CEO pay (0.23 against total assets, r2 0.34, n=21) holds below $580m of DAF assets and to give a DAF-allocated pay per $bn and per account

rationale: Among the 21 top-50 community foundations, TY2024 median top-officer pay is $725,134 and grew 6.6%/yr TY2021-24 (matched median), faster than median DAF assets (+4.5%/yr); per $bn of DAF assets it is $733,697 against $14,336-$76,458 at the four self-staffed nationals.
